## What he does
- Full stack web development: admin portals, dashboards and SaaS products (React.js, Node.js, MySQL, PostgreSQL)
- Product development: turning business requirements into working software, from first idea to launch
- Mobile apps: cross-platform React Native apps with Firebase, push notifications and live tracking
- Backend and REST APIs: Node.js and PHP (CodeIgniter), with OWASP-aware security practices
- AI agents and chatbots: OpenAI, OpenCV and TensorFlow, including AI call transcription
- Payments and communication: Stripe, PayPal, Authorize.Net, Twilio voice and SMS, WebRTC
